tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List the available markets (countries/regions), their language, content and license terms.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description:
Search recent government press releases in one market. Free (does not use quota).

    Args:
        market: us, kr, gb, eu, nz or au (see list_markets). kr articles are in Korean —
            search them with Korean keywords (e.g. 반도체, 수출).
        query: keywords; every word must appear in the he

tools.name: get_article
tools.description:
Get the full text of one article (counts 1 toward the monthly quota; re-reading is free).

    Args:
        market: the article's market (us, kr, gb, eu, nz, au).
        id: the article id from search_articles.
    Returns headline, body, source agency, time, original link and the required copyrig

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Show the API key's plan, monthly quota and how much has been used.
